name: ASB Auto Subs
description: An extension to automatically download the subtitle file of the currently played anime intended to be used with ASB Player to add the downloaded subtitles to the video.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://jimaku.cc https://graphql.anilist.co http://127.0.0.1:8766 ws://127.0.0.1:8766
